tools.description: List the 24 canonical Mangii art styles with live style ids. Call this before manga.create_story. Experimental and alias ids are excluded. Filter with group or limit when you only need one look.

group.description: Optional style group. Example: shonen_action or painterly_artistic. Omit to return every selectable style.

limit.description: Optional max number of styles to return after filtering. Example: 6.

error.description: Machine error code such as invalid_request, insufficient_credits, or quality_forbidden.

message.description: Human-readable error. Never includes stack traces or internal paths.

id.description: Pass this as style_id on manga.create_story. Example: classic_shonen.

name.description: Human display name. Example: Classic Action.

tools.description: Return the API wallet. Spendable is apiPackCredits plus purchase-backed packCredits. weeklyCredits is display-only and does not pay MCP or HTTP generate. Use this before a paid tool to see if you need manga.buy_credits.

include_notes.description: When true (default), include a notes string explaining that weeklyCredits does not spend on API or MCP.

tools.description: List panels you own for a story. Use this to get panel_id values before changing Image 1 or Image 2 on manga.continue_story or manga.regenerate_panel. Each row has ref_role: identity on the first panel, scene on the last distinct panel, otherwise null.

story_id.description: Story id from manga.create_story. Example: a Firestore story document id returned as story_id.

image_url.description: HTTPS URL of this panel image.

order_index.description: Zero-based reading order. First panel is 0.

tools.description: Start a new private manga (panel 1). Required: prompt + style_id from manga.list_styles. Optional identity_image or reference_image is Image 1. Style locks. Default async=false returns image_url, story_id, panel_id. Then manga.continue_story. Costs 1/2/5 credits by quality.

async.description: On this MCP server the default is false: wait and return image_url in one call. Set true only if you will poll manga.get_job. HTTP API default remains async.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key on retry so a timeout does not charge twice. 8-200 chars. Omit to mint a one-shot key (unsafe on retry).

identity_image.description: Replacement photo: https URL or data:image/...;base64,... URI. Public hosts only. Same slot cannot also send a panel id.

prompt.description: Scene in everyday language: characters, place, action, mood, camera, weather, color or black-and-white. Example: "A duel under cherry blossoms, low angle, rain, full color." Max 2000 characters.

quality.description: Generation quality. standard costs 1 credit, hd 2, ultra 5. Default standard. HD/Ultra need an unlocked API wallet.

reference_image.description: Optional first-panel identity photo. https URL or data URI. Alias of identity_image.

style_id.description: Canonical style id from manga.list_styles. Example: classic_shonen or cinematic_anime. Locked after panel 0.

title.description: Optional story title shown in the library. Example: "Rain Duel". Omit to let Mangii name it.

reference_image.description: Alias for identity_image. Replaces Image 1 with an uploaded photo or URL.
